summary: The corrected lookup sentence now agrees with retained code: 29c260 accepts a one-based insertion position and returns a material-node pointer or null; a nonempty list returns its head for requested positions <=1. 1d7090 forwards the pointer in RAX. Only this contract string and its dependent validation byte count/hash changed. A-G2-01 is resolved.

checked_semantics: Input is a requested insertion position; output is a node pointer or null, not an ordinal or material ID.
Empty list returns null. Exhausted traversal returns null.
For a nonempty list, requested positions <=1 return the head; no general position validation is implied.
Normal DB material/relation traversal loops start at0, test against n and pass i+1, hence positions1..n when entered.
1d7090 forwards the pointer in RAX with no overwrite between the call and return.
Relation callers null-check and dereference node pointers to obtain relation-key IDs.
The separate exact-ID lookup and its first-match behavior are not conflated with positional lookup.

source_anchors.support: Initializes local_10 from head, increments traversal counter in the loop condition, follows next+0x2200, and returns local_10.
